items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: He used to play with Clay Jones. He had a great big bass drum.

ctx.x: What about Clay Jones? Did you ever hear him?
Bass drum? Yeah. He used to play with Clay Jones. He had a great big bass drum. One of them big ones.
That looks tall. That looks 36 inches or something. Wasn't that big, huh? Well, that's about as high as that. About as high as that pure old.
